ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, some with darker charred or browned tips, firm bumpy surfaces, clustered in the upper-left of the plate, florets about 2-3 cm across, slightly glossy with faint seasoning flecks | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow scrambled eggs in soft, moist, fluffy curds with small clumps, slightly glossy, spread across the upper-right of the plate, covering roughly a quarter of the plate in a mound about 2 cm high | 130
ITEM 3 | Fresh dark green spinach leaves, flat and wilted in parts, some with pale stems, lying across the lower-left of the plate under and beside the broccoli, leaves about 5-8 cm long | 45
ITEM 4 | Thin shreds of orange carrot scattered among the spinach, bright orange, matchstick-like strips about 3-4 cm long, few in number | 8
ITEM 5 | Cooked bacon strips, reddish-brown to dark brown with crisp edges and translucent fatty sections, slightly glossy and rendered, lying in overlapping strips on the lower-right of the plate, each strip about 10-12 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide | 40
